notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Walking Ballista.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and casuing you to gain 1 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Repeat from step 2.
